Bán lại Sun Saphia Residence trước bàn g: Reselling Sun Saphia Residence before handover is a resale of the sale and purchase agreement: it requires the developer's confirmation, the buyer continues paying the remaining installments, and the pool of buyers interested in purchasing a contract is usually narrower. After the certificate is issued, the asset is complete, buyers can see the actual unit and take out a bank mortgage on it, so the buyer pool is wider – but you will have paid in full, paid management fees and borne furnishing costs during the holding period.
